device.modelDescription: echo whatever in API input to response output

actionList.name: echo
actionList.description: Echoes the input object back as the output, unmodified. Useful for verifying end-to-end connectivity and input/output schema handling.

actionList.name: echoAsync
actionList.description: Same as echo, but implemented with an async/await handler instead of a callback -- exercises the async invocation code path.

actionList.name: testTimeout
actionList.description: Intentionally never calls back, so the framework's action timeout fires. Used to test timeout handling; expect a DEVICE_NOT_RESPONDING-style error.

actionList.name: testTimeoutAsync
actionList.description: Same as testTimeout, but implemented as an async function that never resolves.

actionList.name: testErrorInfo
actionList.description: Returns a device-defined error object (fault) instead of a normal result, to test structured error propagation.

actionList.name: testFunctionReturnError
actionList.description: Returns a JavaScript Error instance directly from the action function, to test that error type is handled correctly.

actionList.name: testNullReturnError
actionList.description: Returns null as the error value, to test that a falsy/null error is still treated as "no error" correctly.

actionList.name: testNumberTypeReturnError
actionList.description: Returns a number as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

actionList.name: testStringTypeReturnError
actionList.description: Returns a string as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

actionList.name: testBooleanTypeReturnError
actionList.description: Returns a boolean as the error value, to test error normalization when the device module supplies a non-Error error.

actionList.name: testErrorInfoAsync
actionList.description: Async/await version of testErrorInfo: rejects with a device-defined error object to test structured error propagation.

actionList.name: testThrowError
actionList.description: Directly throws a new Error inside a callback-style action handler, to test that synchronous throws are caught and reported as a fault rather than crashing the process.

actionList.name: testThrowErrorAsync
actionList.description: Directly throws a new Error inside an async/await-style action handler, to test that async throws are caught and reported as a fault rather than crashing the process.

actionList.name: testAsyncThrowInDomain
actionList.description: Throws asynchronously (outside the initial call stack) inside a callback-style action handler, exercising Node's deprecated domain-module-based exception capture.

actionList.name: testAsyncThrowInAsync
actionList.description: Throws asynchronously inside an async/await-style action handler; expected to be caught by a try/catch block rather than relying on the domain module.
